## Problem

What payment, wallet, verification, reconciliation or consumer-integration task should be easier?

## Proposed solution

Describe the package, contract or adapter you want to change.

## Ownership boundary

application.

## Security and compatibility

Describe cluster, token-program, mint-extension, transaction-version, state-machine, schema,
migration and release implications.
